title: JakeLib
description: JakeLib is a small Fabric helper library for Minecraft mods, offering reusable utilities for inventories, item stacks, text, colors, timers, cooldowns, math, strings, and shape template data. It includes a /jakelib command to confirm the mod is loaded.
body: JakeLib is a small Fabric helper library for Minecraft mods, offering reusable utilities for inventories, item stacks, text, colors, timers, cooldowns, math, strings, and shape template data. It includes a /jakelib command to confirm the mod is loaded.
